title: txn.related params
description: Evaluations linked to an anchor evaluation. The Edge resolves each link key internally (CARD = pan_hash, MERCHANT = merchant_id, DEVICE = features.device_id, ACCOUNT = features.account_id or features.customer_id, IP = features.ip_address) and never returns the key value. Window is +/- windowDays around the anchor's evaluatedAt. Paged with request.page.
